Five minutes before halftime, TFC's situation deteriorated when Giovinco and Altidore were foiled by the encroaching referee; a goal kick was granted, and Montreal scored again almost instantly.
TFC midfielder Benoit Cheyrou committed a foul on Piatti, providing an opportunity for Impact's substitute, Romualdo, to unleash a high free kick towards the north end goal.
On the next kick, Piatti sent a game-sealing volley sailing just wide.
